title: Preservation of the invariant in one rewrite step
statement: Suppose a gate-emission procedure satisfies the gadget specification for every eligible gate and acyclic existing list. If a rewritten state satisfies the invariant for an acyclic original list, adjoining a gate $g$ preserves the invariant provided the enlarged original list remains acyclic and the gate's kind and argument count satisfy $Q$. The resulting state is obtained by one rewrite step using the emission procedure.
hypotheses_covered: Predicates Q on gate kind and argument count and P on gates
Emission procedure satisfies the gadget specification for every eligible gate and acyclic existing list
Existing original gate list old and gate g
Current state satisfies the rewriting invariant for old
Appending g to old gives an acyclic list
